title: Charles Emmanuel I of Savoy's cipher letters to his ambassador in London, Giovanni Battista Gabaleone (Infanta Maria - Prince Henry match)
correspondents: Charles Emmanuel I, Duke of Savoy -> Giovanni Battista Gabaleone, Savoyard ambassador in London
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Torino, Corte, Materie politiche per rapporto all'interno, Matrimoni della Real Casa di Savoia, mazzo 25, fasc. 7 (seal database); inventory n. 102 lists mazzo 25 fasc. 4 "Lettere diverse del Duca ... al Caval.e Gabaleone, Ambasciadore ... in Londra", 1612-1619
folio_note: Two letters described in the ASTo seal database as "Lettera cifrata di Carlo Emanuele I duca di Savoia indirizzata a Giovanni Battista Gabaleone ambasciatore a Londra": did=490 (16/10/1612, red wax seal under paper, endorsement "... 9bre" visible on the seal photo, i.e. the letter as received and brought back) and did=1197 (21/7/1613). File title: "Matrimonio progettato tra l'Infanta Maria ... ed il principe di Galles Enrico Federico".
status: Description only: the catalogue calls both letters "lettera cifrata"; the seal photos show no text. Whether a decipherment is written on them (as received copies often have) is not known.
why: Savoyard ducal cipher of 1612-13 on the English marriage negotiation, from the received originals; Gabaleone's own despatches survive (ASTo Lettere Ministri Gran Bretagna m. 1; BL Add MS 32023 A-B transcripts), which may give the clear text or the key.
verify: Order scans of did=490 and did=1197 (mazzo 25 fasc. 7 / fasc. 4); check for an interlinear decipherment; look for the Gabaleone cipher in Lettere Ministri Gran Bretagna m. 1 and in BL Add MS 32023 A-B.

title: Cardinal Maurizio of Savoy's cipher letter to abate Buschetti, ambassador of the 'principi cognati' at Milan (Savoyard civil war)
correspondents: Cardinal Maurizio of Savoy -> abate Buschetti, envoy of the princes Maurizio and Tommaso to the Spanish governor of Milan
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Torino, Corte, Materie politiche per rapporto all'interno, Tutele, reggenze e luogotenenze generali, mazzo 4
folio_note: ASTo seal database did=1388: "Lettera cifrata del cardinale Maurizio di Savoia all'abate Buschetti", Nice, 7/7/1640, Maurizio's seal (red wax under paper). The same database lists clear letters to Buschetti of 1 Jul 1640 (did=714, Maurizio) and five from Prince Tommaso (did=1382-1386): the Buschetti file of the princes' party.
status: Description only: the catalogue calls it "lettera cifrata"; the seal photo (1630 px) shows only faint show-through of a few signs, too faint to say whether they are cipher figures. Gloss unknown.
why: A cipher of the princes' party in the Savoyard civil war (1639-42), with clear sibling letters to the same envoy in the same file for cribs.
verify: Order scans of mazzo 4 (did=1388 and siblings did=714, 1382-1386); check for a decipherment on the leaf or among the siblings.

title: Venetian "Lettere in cifra" to the Provveditori alle biave from the bailo at Constantinople (1589-97) and the ambassador in Spain (1590)
correspondents: Venetian bailo at Constantinople; Venetian ambassador in Spain -> Provveditori alle biave (grain magistracy), Venice
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Venezia, "Secreta, lettere in cifra ai provveditori alle biave" (per the 1991 inventory; series number not given in the portal), inventory "Lettere in cifra indirizzate prevalentemente ai Provveditori alle biave dal bailo di Costantinopoli (1589-1597) e dall'ambasciatore veneto in Spagna (1590)"
folio_note: Archivi Nazionali guide record sdr 43087032 (inventory compiled 1991, ASVe general series). Its note: "CONTROLLARE: fondo collegato «Secreta, lettere in cifra ai provveditori alle biave»? così nell'inv. ma senza riscontro di SE relativa nel DB".
status: Description only: a small fonds of cipher letters named by an ASVe inventory; extent, busta numbers and any decipherments unknown.
why: Bailo cipher letters on grain supply in the 1590s, sent to a magistracy outside the Senate's Deciferazioni series, so possibly never deciphered into the Senate registers.
verify: Ask ASVe for the 1991 inventory and the busta numbers; check against Senato, Dispacci Costantinopoli and Deciferazioni for the same dates; the CX key books (Cifre, chiavi e scontri di cifra) hold the 1578-87/1590s ambassadors' cipher.
access_note: Not digitised; the portal gives only the inventory title. ASVe reading room or a reference enquiry.
prior_art: known.py: no hit for "biave" or "bailo di Costantinopoli". Web search (6 Nov 2026) found nothing on these letters. DECODE, Tomokiyo, Lasry not searched.

title: Banco di San Giorgio: Corsican commissioners' letters 'often partly in cipher', filed with 'several' of their keys (Montebruni filza 1560)
correspondents: Commissari generali of Corsica Andrea Imperiale, Pellegro Giustiniano, Gaspare Cattaneo, Nicolò Grimaldi and local officials -> Protettori of the Casa di San Giorgio, Genoa
place: Bastia, Ajaccio, Balagna, Capraia, Calvi -> Genoa
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Genova, Casa di San Giorgio, Affari generali, Cancelleria dei Protettori, cancelliere Francesco Montebrunus Cybo, filza "[...] ebruni [...] 1560" / "Anno 1560. Francesco Cibo M..." (ARK ark:/22580/ua_25838904)
folio_note: Filza of 111 unnumbered cc. and fascicles. Inventory: "a) lettere, spesso parzialmente in cifra, dei commissari generali ... copie di dispacci provenienti dall'estero e di missive di privati intercettate ...; parecchi cifrari dei funzionari di stanza in Corsica (commissario generale e commissari locali, vicario e luogotenenti)".
status: Description only. Keys of the same officials are in the same filza, so the cipher passages should be readable from them.
why: Genoese colonial cipher of the Corsican war years (after the 1559 return of Corsica to San Giorgio), with the senders' keys in the same filza: a key-plus-ciphertext set from an archive not yet in the catalogue.
verify: Order photos of the cipher letters and the cifrari in the filza; pair each letter with its commissioner's key.
